parameters.query:
SELECT 
  a."id" AS agent_id,
  cp."id" AS platform_id,
  a."name" AS agent_name,
  a."systemInstruction" AS system_prompt,
  a."welcomeMessage" AS greeting,
  a."welcomeImageUrl" AS welcome_image,
  a."followupConfig" AS followup_config,
  a."handoverConfig" AS handover_config,
  COALESCE(a."knowledgeBase", '') || E'\n\n' || 
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT string_agg(
        '=== ' || ks.title || ' ===' || E'\n' || ks.description || 
        CASE WHEN ks."fileUrl" IS NOT NULL 
          THEN E'\nAttached File (' || COALESCE(ks."fileName", 'file') || '): ' || ks."fileUrl"
          ELSE '' 
        END,
        E'\n\n'
      )
      FROM "KnowledgeSources" ks
      WHERE ks."agentId" = a.id
    ),
    ''
  ) AS knowledge
FROM "ConnectedPlatforms" cp
JOIN "Agents" a ON cp."agentId" = a.id
WHERE cp."sessionId" = $1;
